wall_lines: This page is a viewer. It has no ingest, live, shadow, loop, or refresh control.
No paper deposit, withdraw, or transfer. No cash movement of any kind.
No trade arming, no one-tap bet, no Kalshi account, key, or wallet scope.
AI NEVER DEPOSITS / WITHDRAWS / TRANSFERS CASH.
hard_nos: No ingest / live / shadow / loop / refresh controls
No trade arming, one-tap bet, or Kalshi trade keys
No API keys, secrets, or .env values on the page or in the committed client JS
Missing charts stay "not yet available" — never invented
Never claim edge / banked edge / "edge established"
Never blur the golf WC1 FAIL into the 15-minute learning lane

observation.label: Paper hit rate
observation.note: The share of unplaced paper tickets that would have come in. Not edge, not a validated edge, not ROI, not a track record, not banked money.

notes: The two pending rows keep SETTLE_PENDING rather than being defaulted to a loss to make the page look finished. Their finishes are not invented.
They are held outside the settleable denominator so they can neither inflate nor deflate the paper hit rate.

The staged export settle_join_summary.json records SETTLE_PENDING_cleared: false against its own 124-row relevant denominator. Both statements are true of different denominators; the export is not edited to make them agree.
